1: Truth: not only accurate facts but reality as God reveals it in Jesus.
Faith or trust, and also faithfulness; Hebrews 11 is its great chapter.
Literally 'of the age': the life of the age to come, which begins now.
Used only here in the whole New Testament.
The mind as the way we think and judge; Romans 12:2 calls for it to be renewed.
2: Patient endurance, literally 'remaining under' a heavy load without giving way.
Used only here in the whole New Testament.
To arrange under or put in order; Ephesians 5:21 begins with mutual submission.
Rescue and deliverance, from danger as well as from sin.
3: Gentleness or meekness: strength under control, not weakness.
Kindness and goodness that is useful to others.
Compassion shown to someone in need; the Greek Old Testament uses it for Hebrew chesed, steadfast love.
A courtroom word: to declare someone in the right, the verdict God gives to those who trust Christ.
Love of friendship and affection; John 21 moves between this and agapaō when Jesus questions Peter.
